definitions.content:
name: fct_orders
description: 'One row per order, all statuses; booked amount is not recognized revenue. Population: One row per order, all statuses; booked amount is not recognized revenue.'
model: ref('fct_orders')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: ordered_at
entities:
  - name: order
    type: primary
    expr: order_id
  - name: customer
    type: foreign
    expr: customer_id
dimensions:
  - name: status
    type: categorical
  - name: ordered_at
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: country_code
    type: categorical
measures:
  - name: order_total
    agg: sum
    expr: order_total
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: demo_currency_units
          null_rule: never
  - name: order_count
    agg: sum
    expr: order_count
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: One row per order, all statuses; booked amount is not recognized revenue.
        parent:
          model: stg_orders
          key:
            order_id: order_id
      assumptions:
        - decision: Population
          chosen: One row per order, all statuses; booked amount is not recognized revenue.
          evidence: default
          detail: Preserve every entity from the driving relation.
          column: order_id

name: orders
label: Orders
description: All-status order analytics in demo currency units where applicable.
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: order_count

name: booked_amount
label: Booked amount
description: All-status order analytics in demo currency units where applicable.
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: order_total

name: average_order_value
label: Average order value
description: All-status order analytics in demo currency units where applicable.
type: ratio
type_params:
  numerator: booked_amount
  denominator: orders
